top_findings.title: 3 of 14 tests fail — the temp-DB fixture never takes effect, so tests share one on-disk books.db
top_findings.evidence: app.py:8 binds DB_FILE at import time, so test_app.py:15 setting os.environ['DATABASE'] after `from app import app, init_db` (test_app.py:5) has no effect. Verified by running `python3 -m pytest test_app.py -q` on a clean copy of app.py+test_app.py: `3 failed, 11 passed`, with pytest's captured setup showing the DB opened at <cwd>/books.db, not the tempfile. Failures: test_get_all_books_empty (test_app.py:93 `assert data == []` got 1 leaked book), test_get_all_books_with_data (test_app.py:111 `assert 2 == 1`), test_get_books_by_author (test_app.py:149 `assert 4 == 2`).
top_findings.suggestion: Read the DB path per request (e.g. `def db_path(): return os.environ.get('DATABASE','books.db')` called inside get_db_connection), or expose a create_app(db_path) factory, so the fixture's tempfile is honoured and each test starts empty.
